leaves.name: y3ToP1j
leaves.doc: y3-p1j (leaf, kind consequence, flag ELLIOT): the manuscript's map Y3 -> P^1_j (diophantine_zq.tex L420-440; normalizer quotient cited to Baba-Granath and Lin-Yang at L420-422): on every fine witness, pi : Y -> P^1 with fibres = Aut(O)-twist classes, CM values 0, oo, -16/27 exactly at discriminants -4, -3, -24, onto P^1(Qbar), fibres of at most 324 points.
leaves.flag: ELLIOT: the manuscript's own claim (L425-440) with the normalizer quotient identified by Baba-Granath Thm 2.1 / Lemma 3.1 and Lin-Yang (L420-422); not printed form; GLUE until a reviewer rates it (row in scratch/y3-x6b/kinds-rows.tsv, as y3-p1j proposed)
leaves.source: diophantine_zq.tex L420-440; Baba-Granath, Canad. J. Math. 60 (2008) Thm 2.1, Lemma 3.1, section 3.1 table (UNVERIFIED)

glue.name: heckeSqrtBranchAny
glue.doc: sgr-direct's HeckeSqrtBranchAny (unchanged statement, SGRDirectNV.lean:1143): for a triple with R1fp, R1hecke, R2fp and a finite Galois E/Q(X) with the normalization chart, E contains sqrt(c(27X+16)) for some c in Q^x. Formerly a theorem from Elkies' model of X6; on the Y3 route it is the quadratic subcover of Y3 -> P^1_j ramified over -16/27 and oo (ON THE SPOT argument in docs/research/y3-x6b.md section 4 (= y3-x6.md section 4); not in the manuscript, whose route L481-526 is local at p > 324).
